const emb = Array.isArray($json.data) && $json.data[0] ? ($json.data[0].embedding || []) : [];
const embLit = '[' + emb.join(',') + ']';
const input = $input.first().json || {};
const query = input.query || '';
const product = input.product || '';
const top_k = input.top_k || 6;
const tenant = String(input.tenant_slug || 'levinnovation').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9-_]/g, '') || 'levinnovation';

const safeProduct = product ? "'" + product.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : "NULL";
const safeQuery = query.replace(/'/g, "''");
const safeTenant = tenant.replace(/'/g, "''");
const safeEmb = embLit;

const sql = `WITH params AS (
  SELECT '${safeEmb}'::vector AS qvec,
         '${safeQuery}'::text AS qtext,
         ${safeProduct}::text AS product,
         '${safeTenant}'::text AS tenant,
         ${top_k}::int AS k
),
v AS (
  SELECT c.id, c.text,
         c.metadata || jsonb_build_object(
           'doc_id', d.id::text,
           'title', COALESCE(d.title, c.metadata->>'title', c.metadata->>'source_name', 'doc'),
           'url', COALESCE(d.url, c.metadata->>'url', ''),
           'mime', COALESCE(d.mime, c.metadata->>'mime', ''),
           'visibility', COALESCE(d.visibility, 'context_only'),
           'tenant_slug', d.tenant_slug
         ) AS metadata,
         1 - (c.embedding <=> p.qvec) AS vscore,
         row_number() OVER (ORDER BY c.embedding <=> p.qvec) AS vrank
  FROM cs_knowledge_chunks c
  JOIN cs_documents d ON d.id = c.doc_id
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE d.tenant_slug = p.tenant
    AND (p.product IS NULL OR c.metadata->>'product' = p.product)
  ORDER BY c.embedding <=> p.qvec
  LIMIT 30
),
f AS (
  SELECT c.id, c.text,
         c.metadata || jsonb_build_object(
           'doc_id', d.id::text,
           'title', COALESCE(d.title, c.metadata->>'title', c.metadata->>'source_name', 'doc'),
           'url', COALESCE(d.url, c.metadata->>'url', ''),
           'mime', COALESCE(d.mime, c.metadata->>'mime', ''),
           'visibility', COALESCE(d.visibility, 'context_only'),
           'tenant_slug', d.tenant_slug
         ) AS metadata,
         ts_rank_cd(c.tsv, websearch_to_tsquery('spanish', p.qtext)) AS fscore,
         row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ts_rank_cd(c.tsv, websearch_to_tsquery('spanish', p.qtext)) DESC) AS frank
  FROM cs_knowledge_chunks c
  JOIN cs_documents d ON d.id = c.doc_id
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE d.tenant_slug = p.tenant
    AND (p.product IS NULL OR c.metadata->>'product' = p.product)
    AND c.tsv @@ websearch_to_tsquery('spanish', p.qtext)
  LIMIT 30
),
fused AS (
  SELECT u.id, u.text, u.metadata,
         COALESCE(1.0/(60+MAX(u.vrank)),0) + COALESCE(1.0/(60+MAX(u.frank)),0)
         - CASE WHEN u.metadata->>'source' = 'static' THEN 0.05 ELSE 0 END AS score
  FROM (
    SELECT id, text, metadata, vrank, NULL::int AS frank FROM v
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id, text, metadata, NULL::int, frank FROM f
  ) u
  GROUP BY u.id, u.text, u.metadata
)
SELECT id, text, metadata, score
FROM fused
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT (SELECT k FROM params);`;

return [{ json: { embedding_literal: embLit, query, product, top_k, tenant_slug: tenant, sql_query: sql } }];
